newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-SCOTS STICK TO WINNING FORMULA.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-SCOTS STICK TO WINNING FORMULA.

text.p: Scotland announced an unchanged line-up on Tuesday for the all-important Five Nations match with France at Parc des Princes on March 15.
The same team involved in the record 38-10 win over Ireland at Murrayfield will reappear in Paris, attempting to deny the French their first grand slam in a decade.
There are only six survivors. including Doddie Weir who came on as a replacement, from the Scottish team who secured their first win in Paris for 26 years on their last visit in 1995.

Team - 15-Rowen Shepherd; 14-Tony Stanger, 13-Alan Tait, 12-Gregor Townsend, 11-Kenny Logan; 10-Craig Chalmers, 9-Bryan Redpath; 8-Peter Walton, 7-Ian Smith, 6-Rob Wainwright (captain), 5-Andy Reed, 4-Doddie Weir, 3-Mattie Stewart, 2-Graham Ellis, 1-Tom Smith.
